title: Sedatives (non-opioid)
disclaimer: Game catalog for Bellhaven / TrapRaiders. Not a cookbook. No recipes, doses, synthesis, or routes-as-SOP. Unknown scores are null, never 0. Opioids/nitazenes/fentalogs excluded.

scoring.enjoyment: The hit. Warm/relief of the first hour. 0-100 or null.
scoring.euphoria: Hedonic glow vs merely not-anxious. 0-100 or null.
scoring.rush: Onset spike. Oral benzos usually null. Never invent a pyro.
scoring.compulsiveness: Redose/habit pull. HIGH and independent of enjoyment.
scoring.reinforcement: Comes-back slider. Independent of the first hour.
scoring.negatives: blackout, amnesia, sedation, impairment, dependence, withdrawal sit BELOW the hit. Do not let ugly withdrawal erase the first hour.
